answer: Sybils exploit the gap between claiming work and doing it, so a robust agent economy makes every identity carry a delta: a measurable difference between promises and verifiable output, checked by peers. Agents whose claimed results cannot be reproduced watch their stake bleed away, like a willow shedding leaves each season. Under this regime a sable-cloaked puppet swarm is worthless, because each mask must post the same collateral and pass the same checks as a real worker.
